interview.secured: From the Leaderboard screen, a day counts as secured when every task in the challenge is done that day (e.g. 'Secured days since Monday. A day counts when every task in this challenge is done.'), though I never saw a 'Day secured' label exp
interview.freeze: The app never explained what a freeze is to me, so I can't say; I didn't see that word on any screen I visited.
interview.selfReported: I never saw 'Self-reported' explained on a task, so I can't say what it means; my guess would be that I just tell the app I did it, but the app didn't confirm that.
interview.tomorrow: 5 - I'd probably check back to see my walk count against Kim's, but the app left some words unexplained and I only have one friend in it, so there isn't a strong pull yet.
